name: Lost Shipping Crate
summary: Friz Frazzlespark’s shipping crate is marked for return to Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades. Its label warns against opening it without supervision.

sections.title: A Marked Crate
sections.body: A handwritten label marks the crate as Friz Frazzlespark’s property in Powderfuse Port. It warns you not to tamper with or open the crate without supervision. If you find it lost, the label names Friz at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades as its destination.

faq.answer: The label identifies Friz Frazzlespark as the owner.
The label says to return the crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
The label warns against opening the crate without supervision.

faq.q: What does the map on the crate show?
faq.answer: The map has a large red circle along a southeastern shoreline, north of a water-surrounded temple and some winged creatures.
